description: A tabletop holds a wire basket, a narrow metal tray, and a spread of colorful plastic utensils (spoons, forks, and knives). The right hand reaches to the far-right utensils and sweeps them together into a bundle as a right-hand object, then both hands briefly separate out a blue utensil, after which the right hand lowers the bundled utensils into the metal tray to insert them, and finally lifts and positions the filled tray closer to the wire basket.
